entries.f81c3b19687ea937: The corporate philosophy is "Everyone Be Friends," and the vision is "One World, Connecting Smiles." In May 2025, the company announced a ten-year long-term vision, "Lighthouse Guiding Everyone to Smiles - Roadmap to a World of Smiles." Under the three-year medium-term management plan "From Uncertain Growth to Stable and Sustainable Growth" (fiscal year ended March 2025 to fiscal year ending March 2027), the company is advancing global Evergreen IP development through a review of marketing and sales strategies, building a global growth foundation, and expanding its IP portfolio and diversifying monetization.
